title: A Nonparametric Approach to Pricing and Hedging Derivative Securities Via Learning Networks
question: Can a network learn option pricing from prices alone?
changed: Neural networks trained on simulated and real data recover Black–Scholes-like prices and usable hedges.

title: Regression Shrinkage and Selection via the Lasso
venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B (Methodological)
question: How do you fit a regression with many candidate predictors?
changed: An L1 penalty shrinks coefficients and sets many exactly to zero: selection and shrinkage in one.

title: Foundations of Technical Analysis: Computational Algorithms, Statistical Inference, and Empirical Implementation
question: Can chart patterns be defined by an algorithm and tested?
changed: Kernel regression smooths prices to detect patterns automatically; several carry modest information.

title: Random Forests
question: Can many noisy trees make an accurate, stable predictor?
changed: Average trees grown on bootstrap samples with random feature subsets: low variance, little tuning.

title: Deep hedging
question: Can hedging with frictions be learned instead of derived?
changed: Train a network to hedge a portfolio under costs and constraints by minimizing a convex risk measure.

title: Characteristics are covariances: A unified model of risk and return
question: Are characteristics proxies for risk exposures?
changed: IPCA: latent factors whose loadings depend on characteristics; a few factors price the anomalies.

title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning
question: Which machine learning methods best predict stock returns?
changed: Trees and neural networks roughly double the predictive performance of linear models, mainly through interactions among characteristics.

title: Shrinking the cross-section
question: Can a stochastic discount factor be estimated with many characteristics without overfitting?
changed: Shrink the SDF's coefficients, with a penalty set by economic priors; a sparse characteristics-based SDF doesn't work, a few principal components do.

title: Dissecting Characteristics Nonparametrically
question: Which characteristics provide independent information about returns?
changed: An adaptive group lasso on nonparametric functions: only a dozen or so of 62 characteristics matter.

title: Bond Risk Premiums with Machine Learning
question: Do machine learning methods forecast bond excess returns better?
changed: Neural networks with macro data predict bond returns far better than forward-rate regressions.

title: (Re-)Imag(in)ing Price Trends
question: Can a CNN read chart images like a technical analyst?
changed: Convolutional networks trained on price-volume images predict returns beyond standard trend signals.

title: Can ChatGPT Forecast Stock Price Movements? Return Predictability and Large Language Models
question: Can a large language model read news headlines and predict next-day returns?
changed: LLM sentiment scores of headlines predict next-day returns, and the ability emerges in larger models.

title: Deep Learning in Asset Pricing
question: Can deep networks estimate a no-arbitrage SDF directly?
changed: An adversarial GMM setup: one network builds the SDF, another finds the moments it prices worst.

title: The Virtue of Complexity in Return Prediction
question: Can models with more parameters than observations predict returns better?
changed: In theory and data, heavily over-parameterized ridge models improve out-of-sample Sharpe ratios: complexity as a virtue.
